title: configEnvVar.test.ts mocks a module path that does not exist (vi.doMock("../../src/db")), so the real src/utils/db loads when the case imports the exit engine (before the rails: the live DB)

evidence.note: vi.doMock('../../src/db', ...) with statement names (insertExitState, updateExitState) that no longer exist
exitEngine imports ./utils/db, which the mis-pathed mock does not intercept
with the broken specifier one run added three files to the per-worker test-DB folder; with the fix, none; the same ten tests pass both ways

sibling_sites_checked: mockspec.js resolved all 349 vi.mock / vi.doMock / vi.unmock / vi.doUnmock specifiers in the 84 files (308 relative) against the base-SHA tree: this is the only one that resolves to no file. The SAFE-06 specifier gate (22-11) is the rail for this class. Merged from AUD-TESTQ-002: The vi.mock specifier gate (scripts/check-vi-mock-paths.ts) checks every call: 583 resolved, this one did not.
severity_rationale: S3: the case still asserts the right config value; the defect is a silent mock miss that let the real DB module load (the reach is counted in AUD-TESTU-001) and will be caught by the SAFE-06 gate. Merged with AUD-TESTQ-002 (the same defect, registered from the 22-14 rails discovery); both are S3, so the merged severity stays S3.
recommendation: The path half is fixed: 27f21a8 (22-14) points the mock at ../../src/utils/db and the SAFE-06 gate (red-proofs INDEX rows 27 and 28) guards it. Status stays confirmed because the other half is open: the factory still names insertExitState and updateExitState, which src/utils/db no longer exports, while src/exitEngine.ts imports upsertExitState and deleteExitState; the case passes only because it never touches them. Phase 28: give the mock the current statement names.
affected_cases: custom STOP_LOSS_PCT flows through to exitConfig.stopLossPct
escaped_regression: Any import-time write added to src/utils/db.ts runs during this case while it stays green, because the mock it relies on never applies.
